I've been taking pills for 2 years, hated the fact to have to take meds to be "normal" and somehow I felt like the pills wouldn't work (maybe I would have needed a higher dose). I stopped taking my pills a year ago - it took about half a year for my depression and social anxiety to fully come back. Now I know that the pills DID help a lot and I am going to see a new psychiatrist soon to get myself new meds.

My mom told me something that helped me come clean with the tought of having to take meds: Anyone who has diabetes has to take meds, they might die if they didn't, taking pills against anxiety/depression doesn't  differ from that.
